raw_segments.text: Patilaman rattled a pair of seals' shoulder bones in front of a herd of holoskicky, and
they stopped dead, puffing and blowing.
Then he stepped near and the seals began to move, and Karak headed them inland, and they
never tried to get back to their companions.
Hundreds and hundreds of thousands of seals watched them being driven, but they went on
Kodik was the only one who asked questions, and none of his companions could tell him
anything, except that the men always drove seals in that way for six weeks or two months
